stories.title: Analyzing Seahawks' season-opening win over Patriots
stories.summary: In a Super Bowl LX rematch, the Seahawks kicked off the NFL season with a win but lost QB Sam Darnold to a hip injury.

stories.title: Barry Melrose, former coach and beloved ESPN hockey analyst, dies at 70
stories.summary: Barry Melrose, a former NHL player and coach who was a beloved, longtime hockey analyst for ESPN, has died, his wife, Cindy, told ESPN's Steve Levy.

stories.title: Seahawks QB Darnold set for MRI but 'great news' so far on hip injury
stories.summary: Seahawks quarterback Sam Darnold was ruled out of the season opener against the Patriots after sustaining a hip injury on the opening drive.

stories.title: Maye faults self for costly INTs, calls play in Pats' loss 'unacceptable'
stories.summary: Drake Maye called his 3-interception performance "unacceptable" in a 13-10 season-opening loss to the Seahawks, noting he "lost patience and it cost us."

stories.title: U.S. rolls over Hungary, moves on to FIBA semis
stories.summary: The U.S. routed Hungary 108-56 to advance to the semifinals of the women's FIBA World Cup and stretched its winning streak in the tournament to 34 games.
